patch_description:
The current program has collapsed performance due to extreme parameter sharing (only 3 distinct params). The second program achieved 0.58 score with 10 distinct params using diverse gate types (XX, YY, ZZ) and modest sharing.

This edit restores circuit expressivity by:
1. Using alternating RY parameters (ry_0, ry_1) instead of full sharing
2. Introducing YY and ZZ two-qubit gates alongside XX for richer entanglement patterns
3. Implementing modest parameter sharing on entanglers: xx_even for all even pairs, yy_shared for YY gates, zz_distinct for ZZ gates
4. Using rz_shared for all RZ gates (single post-rotation layer)

This balances parameter economy (10 distinct params) with circuit expressivity, which should significantly improve worst_group_margin and validation margin while maintaining generalization.
